goal: Define, for a FUTURE separately authorized bounded implementation, the smallest deterministic, isolated, pinned document-rendering and rendered-artifact-inspection capability that turns supplied DOCX bytes into (a) an unmodified LibreOffice-rendered PDF and (b) machine-checkable rendered evidence: page count, page size, per-line rendered geometry compatible with the existing evaluate_resume_page_utilization() payload, PDF font inventory, logical hyperlink-occurrence destination parity against the DOCX (deterministic source occurrence model, canonical URIs), text-extraction parity against the DOCX under one exact normalization spec, and mechanically provable text-overflow and text-overlap findings. It exists because PURSUE_TO_GOLD_PACKAGE_V1 (contract at baseline 1588b4d) correctly fails closed with PACKAGE_CAPABILITY_BLOCKED: canonical main has no DOCX->PDF converter, no rendered-geometry producer, no PDF inspector, and no LibreOffice/Poppler. This capability renders and inspects SUPPLIED documents only. It has ZERO authority over Candidate Truth, Match Truth, Pursuit Truth, Application Truth, evidence lineage, claims, tailoring, qualification, recommendation, or submission, and this contract's existence, review, or merge creates ZERO implementation, installation, environment-mutation, or package-runtime authority.
